shellCommands.command: ls -la; git log --oneline -5 2>&1 | head; node --version; npm --version; python3 --version
cat package.json .gitignore; ls node_modules | head -50; find __agent_eval__ | head

export BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3456; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
node src/server.js & P=$!; sleep 0.7
L=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -d 'title=Middlemarch&author=George Eliot&notes=Slow start' localhost:3456/books); echo "$L"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'finish %{http_code}\n' -X POST "$L/finish"
kill $P; sleep 0.3; node src/server.js & P=$!; sleep 0.7
curl -s "$L" | grep -E 'h1|by |Finished|Slow'
kill $P; cat /tmp/smoke/books.json; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
